title: Atrophic gastritis and Helicobacter pylori infection in patients with reflux esophagitis treated with omeprazole or fundoplication
authors: Kuipers EJ, Lundell L, Klinkenberg-Knol EC, Havu N, Festen HP, Liedman B, et al.
population: Two cohorts with reflux oesophagitis: 72 treated with fundoplication in Sweden and 105 treated with omeprazole 20 to 40 mg daily in the Netherlands; Helicobacter pylori not treated
funder: Not read: the publisher page refused access; PubMed indexes the article as Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't.
result: Atrophic gastritis developed in 18 of 59 H. pylori-infected omeprazole-treated patients (P < 0.001) and 2 of 46 uninfected omeprazole-treated patients, and in none of 31 infected and 41 uninfected fundoplication patients. The two cohorts were not randomised and came from different countries.
